verdict.rationale: Evidence shows agents can search history and 'post the threads, not vibes' and orchestrate workflows/reviews, implying some data-derived context surfacing, but there is no explicit documentation of dedicated AI-generated insights, summaries, or suggestion features surfaced to users. Missing for 10: dedicated insight/summary dashboards, proactive suggestion features, and independent confirmation that agents actually generate actionable insights rather than just retrieving raw history.
